$comment: Name moderation word lists (apps/server/src/auth/name-filter.ts). Lower case, letters only. `substring`: blocked anywhere inside a word, and when split across words (after normalization: case, accents, look-alike letters, leetspeak, repeated letters, separators). `token`: blocked only as a whole word, because they occur inside innocent words. `whole`: blocked only as the entire name (digits and separators aside), because they are also ordinary names or words (surnames, given names, other languages). `allow`: innocent words and name stems that contain a `substring` term; a hit inside one of them is ignored. Keep the lists short and curated; add a false-positive test for every allowlist entry.
